description: Source code for ru_emulator_timing_notifier class implementing GPS-based timing notifications, including GPS clock implementation, timing loop, and notifier management.

classes.name: gps_clock
classes.description: A custom GPS clock implementation providing current time adjusted for GPS offset.

methods.name: calculate_ns_fraction_from
methods.description: Calculates fractional nanoseconds within a second from a GPS clock time point.

methods.name: get_symbol_index
methods.description: Calculates symbol index within a second based on fractional nanoseconds and symbol duration.

methods.name: get_current_system_slot
methods.description: Determines current system slot based on GPS time, slot duration, and hyper system frame slots.

methods.name: circular_distance
methods.description: Calculates distance between two values with wrap-around consideration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timing notifier in a separate thread, initializing timing loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timing notifier and waits for thread termination.

methods.name: timing_loop
methods.description: Main loop for timing notifications, polling GPS time and managing symbol timing.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Performs timing calculations, sleep management, and notifies on new symbols.

methods.name: notify_slot_symbol_point
methods.description: Notifies registered notifiers of a new slot and symbol point.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes notifiers to receive timing updates.
